findings.reference_evidence: The reference chairs have substantial exposed metal stems beneath their upholstered bodies, with clearly spread cross bases.
findings.render_evidence: Both rendered chairs have upholstery extending close to the floor, leaving very short visible stems and compressed-looking bases.
findings.proposed_change: Use the single correction to raise the seat and lower upholstery edges and lengthen the exposed pedestal stems, keeping the chair-back tops near their current height.
findings.preserve: Keep two green chairs in front of the white desk, their rounded backs, and the rear office chair and right-wall cabinetry.
findings.check_after: Confirm both chairs show a clear stem between upholstery and cross base, with bases resting on the floor and proportions closer to the reference.
findings.uncertainty: Render noise limits base detail. This is a visible proportion judgment, not an inference of physical dimensions; no extra view is requested.

summary: All four furniture targets are present. One correction to visitor-chair pedestal proportions would improve this stage before advancing.
